meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你从现有成果出发，筛选有潜力的深度学习新方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做研究中已有一定的对比结果，想探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Find and vet novel deep learning research directions from your current results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have baselines and want to explore new research ideas

howto.what: 在你已确认的 current_research 基础上做候选式研究探索:先理解仓库、冻结任务与评测,再给候选想法打分排序,一次试一个改动并收集证据,结果写入 explore_outputs/ 等目录,并附变更记录与可比性报告。
howto.when: 当你已定好任务类别、数据集、评测方法与 SOTA 参考,并明确授权候选式探索、且存在 current_research 时接管。纯代码改动、纯跑实验或 README 复现不走它。

say.text: 在 current_research 上帮我跑一轮候选探索,想法先打分排序
冻结评测来源和 SOTA 参考,列出候选想法并给评分拆解
say.note: 先按预期收益、成本、评测风险排序

say.text: 先试一个候选改动,做冒烟检查再和当前基线对比
say.note: 只呈现真实证据得到的排名

howto.what_en: On your confirmed current_research it explores candidate research ideas: understands the repo, freezes task and evaluation, scores and ranks ideas, tries one change at a time, collects evidence, and writes results to explore_outputs/ with changelog and comparability reports.
howto.when_en: Use when you have already fixed the task family, dataset, evaluation method and SOTA reference, explicitly authorized candidate-only exploration, and a current_research exists. Not for code-only, run-only, or README-first work.

say_en.text: Run one candidate exploration round on current_research, ranking ideas first
say_en.note: Outputs go to explore_outputs/ with changelog and comparability reports

say_en.text: Freeze evaluation source and SOTA reference, list candidate ideas with score breakdowns
say_en.note: Ranked by expected gain, cost, evaluation risk first

say_en.text: Try one candidate change, smoke-check it, then compare with the current anchor
say_en.note: Ranking shown only from real evidence
